items.touhou_little_maid:broom.tip: Requires a maid mounted on a broom in order to fly across the sky. Be advised some flying hostile mobs will still reach you such as Maid Fairies or Phantoms.
items.touhou_little_maid:crafting_table_backpa: Expands your maid's inventory slots up to 18. Makes your maid a portable Crafting Table.
Gives maid resistance to drown damage.
items.touhou_little_maid:explosion_protect_bau: Gives maid resistance to explosion damage.
items.touhou_little_maid:fall_protect_bauble.t: Gives maid resistance to fall damage.
items.touhou_little_maid:film.tip: Your maid is deceased. to revive them, Place this in the altar along with a Gold Ingot, Iron Ingot, Lapis Lazuli, Coal, and Redstone on each pillar, or place it in the Shrine
items.touhou_little_maid:fire_protect_bauble.t: Gives maid resistance to burning damage.
items.touhou_little_maid:furnace_backpack.tip: Expands your maid's inventory slots up to 18. Makes your maid a portable Furnace.
items.touhou_little_maid:hakurei_gohei.tip: A gohei used for creating an altar after you constructed it. Maids holding this gohei can shoot danmaku at hostile monsters.
items.touhou_little_maid:maid_backpack_big.tip: Expands your maid's inventory slots up to 36.
Expands your maid's inventory slots up to 24.
items.touhou_little_maid:maid_backpack_small.t: Expands your maid's inventory slots up to 12.
items.touhou_little_maid:mute_bauble.tip: Silence your maid if you're not a fan of their frequent talking.
items.touhou_little_maid:nimble_fabric.tip: Gives maid the ability to dodge incoming projectiles by teleporting.
items.touhou_little_maid:picnic_basket.tip: Up to four maids will enjoy a picnic when they are idle. Be sure to load this basket with food. This increases favorability with your maids.
items.touhou_little_maid:power_point.tip: Power Points are found as loot, throw it to receive power points.
items.touhou_little_maid:sanae_gohei.tip: A gohei used for creating an altar after you constructed it. Maids holding this gohei can shoot danmaku at hostile monsters.
items.touhou_little_maid:wireless_io.tip: Gap is configurable to send items from chest to maid, or vice versa.

blocks.touhou_little_maid:bookshelf.tip: This brings joy and increases favorability of your maid.
blocks.touhou_little_maid:computer.tip: This brings joy and increases favorability of your maid.
blocks.touhou_little_maid:gomoku.tip: Challenge your maid to a Gomoku board game. Are you able to outsmart your maid in this board game?
blocks.touhou_little_maid:keyboard.tip: This brings joy and increases favorability of your maid.
blocks.touhou_little_maid:maid_bed.tip: Maids rest on this bed when it’s time to sleep. This increases favorability with your maid.
blocks.touhou_little_maid:scarecrow.tip: When placed on the ground, it prevents fairy maids from spawning in a square area.
blocks.touhou_little_maid:shrine.tip: Shrines are found in any loot chest at a rare rate. They can be used for resurrecting your maid, and will reduce your health to one.
blocks.touhou_little_maid:snack_cabinet.tip: Storage container for items. Maids will eat block food placed on top and place block food from their inventory.

entities.touhou_little_maid:broom.tip: Requires a maid mounted on a broom in order to fly across the sky. Be advised some flying hostile mobs will still reach you such as Maid Fairies or Phantoms.
entities.touhou_little_maid:fairy.tip: Flies and shoots danmaku at you. Drops power points when killed.
entities.touhou_little_maid:maid.tip: Tame a maid with a cake and you are able to assist them with their tasks you choose. Look in Memorizable Gensokyo to learn more about it.
